nodes.description: Public mapping in TokenERC20 tracking token balances of addresses.
Hardcoded address of the deployed TokenERC20 contract (0x500Df47E1dF0ef06039218dCF0960253D89D6658).
TokenERC20 instance bound to baseAddr, used for balanceOf reads and transferFrom calls.
Public counter of tokens distributed, incremented by 100 per successful airdrop.
External interface function of TokenERC20 that moves tokens on behalf of _from.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts on any direct ether transfer.
Public airdrop function iterating over an address array and calling transferFrom from msg.sender.
Caller-supplied address used as the token source of the airdrop transfer.
External call bcontract.transferFrom(msg.sender, addrs[i], 100*10**18) executed inside the loop; state is updated after the call.
Arithmetic update distributedAmount += 100 performed once per successful airdrop.
Memory array of recipient addresses supplied by the caller.
Loop index used to iterate over the addrs array.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the external transferFrom call, letting an untrusted caller control the transfer source before state is settled.
The update operation writes the unguarded increment into the distributedAmount state variable.
The addrs parameter is the data source iterated over by sendOutToken.
The local index i drives the loop bound inside sendOutToken.
The loop index i selects addrs[i], the recipient used in the external transferFrom call.
The bcontract state variable supplies the target contract for the external transferFrom call.
sendOutToken performs the external call before distributedAmount is updated, exposing the classic reentrancy ordering.
sendOutToken executes the distributedAmount increment only after the external call returns.
_from is the source address consumed by the transferFrom interface function.
_to is the destination address consumed by the transferFrom interface function.
_value is the amount consumed by the transferFrom interface function.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as the input of the core function transferFrom and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter _to is only meaningful as the input of the core function transferFrom and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter _value is only meaningful as the input of the core function transferFrom and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter addrs is the sole input iterated by sendOutToken and should be folded into that core function.
Local loop index i only exists to select the recipient of the external transferFrom call and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
